title: Sati at Daksha's Yajna: The Uninvited Arrival
description: Driven by an aching longing for her family, Sati arrives uninvited at her father's grand yajna, only to face bitter contempt and public insult. As King Daksha unleashes his wrath upon the Lord of Kailash, a fierce and sacred fire awakens deep within Sati's chest, setting the stage for ultimate tragedy.
